findings.title: Desire as channelled rather than spilled
findings.claim: The contrast can be modeled as channeling versus spilling: covenant does not erase desire but gives its movement a durable, life-bearing course.
findings.mechanism: The focus pouring branch supplies desire released without a sustaining channel, the HSN fortification branch supplies containment, and the nearby covenantal river roles supply continuous flow and a course cut through earth. The model distinguishes directed movement from mere restraint.
findings.reader_payoff: The sexual contrast becomes more precise than restraint versus indulgence: a protected relation can give desire a durable direction.
findings.containment: This cross-domain hydraulic model is unusual, but it is anchored in the focus contrast between guardedness and pouring and in the nearby covenantal rivers. It should be rendered as containment versus directed flow, not as a claim that the river passage directly discusses sexuality.

epistemic.reason: The candidate is a legacy_unbound HFT outlier with a complete four-item trace and an explicitly unusual cross-domain model.
